page.overview:
What is Chita's homeworld?

A planet was the homeworld of the human smuggler Chita. the Galactic Empire arrived to the world and, according to Chita, "made a mess" of the planet and her family, viewing the event as awful. Later, Chita told the former Jedi Gleenu of her homeworld when talking of the planet Zenarita's struggle under Imperial rule, mentioning they were not the only ones that held a grudge against the Empire.

Chita's homeworld was mentioned in "The Smuggler," a non-canon short film released as part of the third volume of the Star Wars: Visions series. The animated short, produced by TRIGGER, was released on Disney+
